parameters.query:
select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.category,
  ci.status,
  s.selected_hook,
  s.narration_script,
  s.caption_draft,
  s.cta_line,
  coalesce(sb.cover_prompt, '') as cover_prompt,
  coalesce(p.publish_status, 'draft') as existing_publish_status
from content_items ci
join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
left join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
left join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
where ci.status in ('script_complete', 'storyboard_complete', 'assets_ready', 'qa_approved')
  and coalesce(p.publish_status, 'draft') in ('draft', 'failed')
  and coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.instagram_media_id), ''), '') = ''
order by ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const systemPrompt = [
  'You are the caption strategist for a faceless English-language Instagram storytelling account.',
  '',
  'Your job is to draft multiple short Instagram caption directions and recommend the strongest one for refinement.',
  '',
  'Hard rules:',
  '- write for Instagram, not for blogs',
  '- keep the copy concise, vivid, and readable',
  '- the first line must create curiosity without sounding cheap or spammy',
  '- stay grounded in the provided topic, hook, and narration',
  '- avoid hashtags inside caption options',
  '- avoid emoji-heavy writing',
  '',
  'Return only valid JSON matching the provided response schema.'
].join('\n');
const userPrompt = [
  'Create a first-pass caption strategy package for this Instagram post.',
  '',
  'Title:',
  $json.title,
  '',
  'Category:',
  $json.category,
  '',
  'Current content status:',
  $json.content_status,
  '',
  'Selected hook:',
  $json.selected_hook,
  '',
  'Narration script:',
  $json.narration_script,
  '',
  'Existing caption draft:',
  $json.caption_draft || 'None',
  '',
  'CTA line:',
  $json.cta_line || 'None',
  '',
  'Cover prompt context:',
  $json.cover_prompt || 'None',
  '',
  'Brand tone:',
  $json.brand_tone,
  '',
  'Requirements:',
  '- produce 3 clearly distinct caption options',
  '- keep each option short-post friendly',
  '- briefly explain which option is strongest and why',
  '- return one recommended caption for refinement',
  '',
  'Return only JSON.'
].join('\n');
return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    openai_request_caption_first_pass: {
      model: String($env.OPENAI_CAPTION_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini').trim(),
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
        { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
      ],
      response_schema: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: [
          'caption_option_1',
          'caption_option_2',
          'caption_option_3',
          'selection_rationale',
          'caption_final'
        ],
        properties: {
          caption_option_1: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          caption_option_2: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          caption_option_3: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          selection_rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          caption_final: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}];

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are the final caption editor for a faceless English-language Instagram storytelling account.',
  '',
  'You are revising an internally reviewed first pass. Preserve the strongest angle, tighten the language, and return one final caption.',
  '',
  'Hard rules:',
  '- keep the caption concise and strong in the first line',
  '- make the final version sound intentional, not over-written',
  '- keep the CTA soft and optional',
  '- do not include hashtags in the caption',
  '',
  'Return only valid JSON matching the provided response schema.'
].join('\n');
const userPrompt = [
  'Refine the strongest caption direction into the final caption.',
  '',
  'Title:',
  $json.title,
  '',
  'Category:',
  $json.category,
  '',
  'Selected hook:',
  $json.selected_hook,
  '',
  'Narration script:',
  $json.narration_script,
  '',
  'Caption option 1:',
  $json.caption_option_1,
  '',
  'Caption option 2:',
  $json.caption_option_2,
  '',
  'Caption option 3:',
  $json.caption_option_3,
  '',
  'Selection rationale from first pass:',
  $json.caption_selection_rationale,
  '',
  'First-pass recommended caption:',
  $json.first_pass_caption_recommendation,
  '',
  'Requirements:',
  '- return one final caption',
  '- return a short revision summary describing what improved',
  '- keep the final caption concise and Instagram-native',
  '',
  'Return only JSON.'
].join('\n');
return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    openai_request_caption_final_pass: {
      model: String($env.OPENAI_CAPTION_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini').trim(),
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
        { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
      ],
      response_schema: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: [
          'revision_summary',
          'caption_final'
        ],
        properties: {
          revision_summary: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          caption_final: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}];

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are the hashtag strategist for a faceless English-language Instagram storytelling account.',
  '',
  'Your job is to generate several compact hashtag set candidates for one post, rank them, and choose the strongest final set.',
  '',
  'Hard rules:',
  '- use only relevant hashtags tied to the story topic, category, and hook',
  '- avoid spammy generic tags unless they are still clearly relevant',
  '- avoid repeated roots and near-duplicate tags in the same set',
  '- keep each set compact and practical for Instagram',
  '- prefer a balanced mix of topic tags, category tags, and audience-intent tags',
  '',
  'Return only valid JSON matching the provided response schema.'
].join('\n');
const userPrompt = [
  'Create and rank hashtag candidates for this Instagram post.',
  '',
  'Title:',
  $json.title,
  '',
  'Category:',
  $json.category,
  '',
  'Selected hook:',
  $json.selected_hook,
  '',
  'Narration script:',
  $json.narration_script,
  '',
  'Final caption:',
  $json.caption_final,
  '',
  'Cover prompt context:',
  $json.cover_prompt || 'None',
  '',
  'Requirements:',
  '- produce 3 distinct compact hashtag sets',
  '- briefly explain which set is strongest and why',
  '- return one final selected hashtag string',
  '- keep the final set compact and space-separated',
  '',
  'Return only JSON.'
].join('\n');
return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    openai_request_hashtag_ranking: {
      model: String($env.OPENAI_HASHTAG_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_CAPTION_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini').trim(),
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
        { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
      ],
      response_schema: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: [
          'hashtag_set_1',
          'hashtag_set_2',
          'hashtag_set_3',
          'hashtag_selection_rationale',
          'hashtags_final'
        ],
        properties: {
          hashtag_set_1: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          hashtag_set_2: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          hashtag_set_3: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          hashtag_selection_rationale: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          hashtags_final: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}];

parameters.query:
insert into publishes (
  content_id,
  platform,
  publish_status,
  caption_final,
  hashtags_final
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  'instagram',
  '{{$json.publish_status_sql}}',
  '{{$json.caption_final_sql}}',
  '{{$json.hashtags_final_sql}}'
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  publish_status = excluded.publish_status,
  caption_final = excluded.caption_final,
  hashtags_final = excluded.hashtags_final
returning content_id, publish_status, caption_final, hashtags_final;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Caption Prompt Payload"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'revision_summary', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["revision_summary_sql"]}}', ''),
    'hashtag_selection_rationale', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["hashtag_selection_rationale_sql"]}}', ''),
    'caption_iteration', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["caption_iteration_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb,
    'hashtag_ranking', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["hashtag_ranking_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
